description: File Security & Resource Management - Implement secure file handling with size limits, memory management for image processing, temporary file cleanup, and consistent evidence filename handling across endpoints.
steps: Add request body size limits and image dimension validation before processing in all upload endpoints
Implement memory-constrained image processing with cleanup in save_manual_clocking_images.php watermarking
Add automatic cleanup of temporary files and failed upload artifacts across all endpoints
Standardize evidence filename generation patterns between save_consolidated_clocking.php and upload_clocking_evidence_images.php
Implement image compression and resizing optimization to minimize upload bandwidth requirements
Add file integrity verification to ensure uploaded evidence files are not corrupted
acceptance_criteria: Upload requests are rejected if body size exceeds configured limits (10MB total)
Image processing never consumes more than 512MB memory per request
Temporary files and failed uploads are cleaned up within 1 hour automatically
Evidence filenames follow consistent pattern: type_learnerID_date_timestamp.ext across all endpoints
Images are compressed to reduce bandwidth - face photos under 500KB, signatures under 250KB
File integrity checks prevent corrupted evidence from being stored
verification: Test large file upload rejection by sending oversized requests
Monitor memory usage during concurrent image processing operations
Verify temporary file cleanup by checking filesystem after failed operations
Test filename consistency across different clocking endpoints
Measure file sizes after compression to verify bandwidth optimization
Test corrupted file rejection by uploading malformed image data
